description: This Python source file defines the AzureContentSafetyTextModerationGuardrail class, which integrates Azure Content Safety Guardrails into a larger language model framework. It includes methods for initializing the guardrail, making asynchronous API requests to Azure's text moderation service, checking severity thresholds, and hooks for pre- and post-call processing to scan content for violations.
